entry.title: Jake Bauers: What’s next for Red Sox after the Jake Bauers signing? Digging into Breslow's next moves, free to read www.nytimes.com/athletic/777...

Boston Red Sox offseason notes: Scott Boras said he's had 'heavy' communication with the Red Sox. Craig Breslow is now president of baseball operations. The Red Sox are conducting an internal audit of their medical staff this offseason. That and more here www.nytimes.com/athletic/777...

Boston Red Sox staff and front office: The worst-kept secret at the GM Meetings is that the Red Sox are shopping Jaren Duran (a year too late, but nonetheless). Sox have also inquired about free agent Seiya Suzuki to add to a lineup that finished 12th in the AL in home runs last season

Darwinzon Hernández: Darwinzon Hernández, a lefty reliever for the Red Sox from 2019-22, pitched for the past 4 seasons for the Fukuoka Softbank Hawks and is negotiating to return to MLB. The Mets are among the teams that have checked in. Last year: 1.41 ERA/55 Ks in 44.2IP
Garrett Whitlock: Red Sox announce they picked up Garrett Whitlock’s $8.25 million team option for 2027.
Nate Eaton: The Red Sox traded Nate Eaton to the Athletics, the first in what is likely to be an offseason-opening flurry of moves in the coming days: www.bostonglobe.com/2026/10/29/s...
